text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket reporting in! Nice to
meet you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do whatever it takes to win
every race I enter! Including getting luck
on my side! That
way, someday, I'll make
my dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! Trainer, thanks sooo much for
choosing
meee! I'm gonna channel these
emotions into
running powerrrr!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
